# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 10 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 33 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_010_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 10

**1** Jesus said: "I have cast fire upon the world, and look, I am watching over it until it blazes."

---

**Translation Notes (LOGOS):**
- "Cast fire upon the world" — the action is already accomplished; perfect tense
- "Watching over it" — Jesus is the guardian of the fire he has set; active, ongoing
- "Until it blazes" — the fire is smoldering; the full conflagration is anticipated
- The saying is confident, not anxious; contrast Luke 12:49 where Jesus wishes it were already kindled
- The fire may signify: the words of the collection themselves, division/purification, spiritual transformation
